statement: One DEVELOPMENT GI haemorrhagic-shock encounter (gi_bleed_57m, gi_bleed_72f) runs the live development pressure authority with the manual norepinephrine control exactly as published, under GI_NOREPINEPHRINE_DEVELOPMENT_AUTHORITY_GRANT_V1. Ten scripted management paths from the same arrival, their categories proposed for the faculty review, show that different decisions give causally different trajectories and the same decisions the same one. Each encounter is read as a management trace (state, priority, action, expected effect, observed response, reassessment, new state) extracted from its own events, every value with one provenance, the resident's reasoning only as expressed, every pressure a committed authority minute, and a development boundary before definitive control of the bleeding that never means cure, bleeding stopped, management complete or safe discharge. No physiology, calibration, grant, snapshot, reader or clinical_core/ source was changed. The human review has NOT been done.

why_not_the_others.B: the source-control boundary is represented conservatively (the first definitive request ends the development encounter and nothing after it is observed) and no path needs haemostasis; that the live page REACHES an unreviewed engine haemostasis (H1) is a declared faculty decision, not a blocker of this package
why_not_the_others.C: the timing is the engine's own deterministic rule (a stated interval governs the turn, otherwise the longest administration; at most 120 minutes a step) and every path states its interval; the declared artefacts (the transfusion hour, observation at turn end) do not change any path's reading
why_not_the_others.D: every trace re-extracts identically from its persisted turns, artifact and arrival; every pressure is a committed authority minute bound by its candidate digest; the causal relations hold by test; a tampered trace, an invented reasoning or a substituted action is refused
why_not_the_others.E: the runner is the page's own order path plus the certified authority hooks, and a test on the REAL page gives the same pressures for the same orders; nothing parallel was built
why_not_the_others.F: the ten misleading lessons are attacked by test on the paths, the traces and the review screens without a material implication; mental status, consciousness and heart rate are not shown; the categories appear only in the final summary
